protocol.pass_a_rule: Freeze every qualifying visually observable INITIATIVE_ATTACK anchor before inspecting/recording linked BANTE_FOLLOW or INITIATIVE_CONFLICT outcomes.
protocol.terminal_sprint_rule: Pure final-sprint/overtake behavior after the field has clearly transitioned to terminal sprint is not a new attack anchor.

expected_line_context_research_only.source: KDreams/Aokei pre-event lineup pages; used only to identify expected leaders/direct followers, never promoted to observed line.

frozen_attack_anchors.basis: Expected leader 5 begins a sustained outside advance from the 5-4-2 line and materially challenges the occupied 3-1-6 forward position.
Expected leader 3 advances from behind the established 5-4-2 order and reaches the forward contest near the one-lap marker.
Expected leader 4 makes a sustained outside forward move from the rear 4-6-2 line toward the occupied 7-led forward position.
Expected leader 2 advances outside from the 2-4 line and materially challenges the 7-led forward order.
Expected leader 3 makes a sustained forward move from the rear 3-6 line and closes into the occupied forward position before terminal sprint.
Expected leader 7 launches from the rear 7-2-6 line while two laps remain and advances past the 1-led line toward the front.
Expected leader 1 counter-advances and draws alongside the now-forward 7 position in a sustained challenge.
Expected leader 5 advances from the rear four-rider line toward the occupied 1-led forward line after the one-lap marker but before terminal sprint.
Expected leader 1 makes a sustained outside challenge from behind the 7-3 line and remains in active forward contest across multiple observations.

excluded_near_finish_movements.rule: No new anchors were created from pure final-sprint/overtake movements after the terminal transition.
excluded_near_finish_movements.notable_example: R4 late acceleration near the finish was not counted as a new INITIATIVE_ATTACK anchor.

terminal_rule: Only these nine frozen anchors may define Batch2 downstream conditional opportunities. Pass B may label linked BANTE_FOLLOW and INITIATIVE_CONFLICT under the unchanged six-second protocol; it may not create, remove, or move anchors based on downstream outcomes.
